d40m213m.baseName: Walplus 168 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White - 306 cm
d40m213m.variantName: Walplus 168 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree - Warm White - 306 cm
d40m213m.sourceDescription: This LED Christmas Tree with Spikes elevates your holiday decor with dynamic lighting patterns and a sleek modern design fit for both indoor and sheltered outdoor settings. Designed for those looking to enhance their festive display, this tree blends seamlessly with a variety of settings, from living rooms to garden spaces. Artfully crafted from metal, it presents an enduring piece that withstands the seasonal wear and tear, adding a lively touch to your festive celebrations. Dynamic Lighting Effects The LED Christmas Tree offers dynamic lighting that continuously changes patterns, creating a captivating visual display. With eight modes, you can personalize how your tree lights up the holidays, turning ordinary moments into memorable events. USB-Powered Convenience This tree is engineered to be powered through USB, making it versatile and convenient for use without traditional power adapters. Simply plug it into any USB port, whether it's a power bank, computer, or adapter, for instant festive illumination. Durable Metal Construction Built with solid metal, the tree provides a robust structure that is abrasion resistant. This choice in material extends the product's life, even in high traffic locations, ensuring it remains part of your seasonal decor for many future gatherings. Versatile Use Suitable for both the living room and sheltered outdoor spaces like patios or terraces, this tree adapts well to various environments, offering consistent festive charm whether displayed in a cozy nook or open veranda. Simple Care and Maintenance To maintain its quality appearance, a simple wipe with a dry cloth is all it takes. This ease of maintenance heightens user convenience, allowing more time for enjoyment rather than upkeep. Product Specifications Colour: Warm white Material: Metal Tree height: 306 cm Durable Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 168 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Cable length: 500 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x LED christmas tree This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

tjvshx5c.baseName: My Christmas Artificial Christmas Garland with 30 LED Lights
tjvshx5c.variantName: My Christmas Artificial Christmas Garland with 30 LED Lights
tjvshx5c.sourceDescription: This 270cm/9ft pre-lit Christmas garland adds a festive touch to mantels, staircases, doorways, windows, fireplaces, banisters and shelves. Made with dense PVC tips and a snow-flocked finish, it creates a lush, natural appearance inspired by real pine. The garland features 30 built-in warm white LED lights that provide a soft, cosy glow and requires 3 AA batteries, which are not included. Its sturdy yet flexible wire core allows it to be bent, twisted and shaped to suit different festive displays, making it suitable for indoor home or office decoration. Specifications: 270 cm pre-lit Christmas garland, dense PVC tips, snow-flocked finish, 30 warm white LED lights, sturdy flexible wire core, battery operated, requires 3 AA batteries (not included), easy to bend and shape, and suitable for indoor festive decoration. Dimensions: Length: 270 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
